items.title: Russian Hacking Suspect Wanted by the FBI Arrested on Thai Resort Island
items.description: Thailand’s Cyber Crime Investigation Bureau said an FBI tip that the “world-class hacker” was traveling to Thailand led to his arrest in Phuket. The post Russian Hacking Suspect Wanted by the FBI Arrested on Thai Resort Island appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Google exposes BadAudio malware used in APT24 espionage campaigns
items.description: China-linked APT24 hackers have been using a previously undocumented malware called BadAudio in a three-year espionage campaign that recently switched to more sophisticated attack methods. [...]

items.title: Chinese APT Infects Routers to Hijack Software Updates
items.description: A unique take on the software update gambit has allowed "PlushDaemon" to evade attention as it mostly targets Chinese organizations.

items.title: 'Matrix Push' C2 Tool Hijacks Browser Notifications
items.description: Have you ever given two seconds of thought to a browser notification? No? That's what hackers bent on phishing are counting on.

items.title: Same Old Security Problems: Cyber Training Still Fails Miserably
items.description: Editors from Dark Reading, Cybersecurity Dive, and TechTarget Search Security break down the depressing state of cybersecurity awareness campaigns and how organizations can overcome basic struggles with password hygiene and phishing attacks.
